title: PlanningBridge
responsibility: Declare planning operations for revision-addressed reads, design versions, options and approvals.

inputs.name: RevisionInput
inputs.description: A branch, tag or commit to read; omission uses the checked-out commit.

inputs.name: DesignImageInput
inputs.description: Complete PNG bytes for one state and viewport.

inputs.name: AddDesignInput
inputs.description: Adds one design version; options describe one to ten alternatives. baseRevision records the source, and expectedLatest guards concurrent updates.

inputs.name: ApproveDesignInput
inputs.description: Approves the latest version and binds the selected option, image hashes and contract hash.

inputs.name: ReadImageInput
inputs.description: Reads an image belonging to the selected unit, version and optional option at a pinned revision; sha256 checks expected content.

outputs.name: PlanningApi
outputs.description: Provides snapshot, listPlans, readPlan, listBranches, listCommits, createPlan, addDesign, openThread, appendMessage, approveDesign, readImage and entityHistory operations.

outputs.name: PlanningBridge
outputs.description: The bridge declares success or failure as a discriminated result rather than throwing.
